DSSSB MTS Result 2026: The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has released the result of the written exam for Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) on its official website i.e., dsssb.gov.in. The marks of 69607 candidates who appeared in the written exam have been uploaded on the Board’s OARS portal. Based on performance in the exam, 1732 candidates have been provisionally shortlisted for uploading their e-dossiers. Along with the marks, DSSSB has also released the list of candidates shortlisted for the next stage of the recruitment process.

DSSSB MTS Result 2026

The result link is given below. Candidates can view their marks by logging into their individual accounts on the OARS module of DSSSB (dsssbonline.nic.in) using their registration details. The board has also released a result notice PDF containing the details regarding e-dossier and the link for the same is also provoided below.

DSSSB MTS Result 2026: Click to Download

DSSSB MTS Result PDF: Click to Download

DSSSB MTS Result 2026 Highlights

The written exam was conducted online on multiple dates between February and May 2026. The recruitment was advertised under Advert No. 03/2024 for 579 MTS vacancies across 15 departments of the Government of NCT of Delhi. More details related to the DSSSB MTS result are given below:

Particulars Details
Exam Conducting Body Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board
Post Multi Tasking Staff (MTS)
Vacancies 579
Candidates Appeared 69,607
Candidates Shortlisted 1732
Exam Mode Online
Maximum Marks 200
DSSSB MTS Result Date 04 September 2026
E-Dossier Dates 07 September to 21 September 2026
Official Website dsssb.delhi.gov.in

DSSSB MTS Cut Off Marks 2026

The cut-off marks for candidates shortlisted for e-dossier submission are given below. The written examination was conducted for a total of 200 marks.

Category Cut Off Marks
UR 183.36
EWS 175.61
OBC 167.43
SC 176.20
ST 161.25
PwBD (a) 169.78
PwBD (b) 155.10
PwBD (c) 94.43
Ex-Servicemen 95.25
SP 128.69

The minimum qualifying marks prescribed by DSSSB are 40%for General/EWS, 35% for OBC (Delhi), and 30% for SC/ST/PH(PwD). Ex-servicemen candidates are eligible for a 5% relaxation in their respective categories, subject to a minimum of 30%.

DSSSB MTS E-Dossier 2026

The shortlisted candidates in the exam are required ti fill the e-dossier and upload all the relevant documents of Educational/Professional Certificates/Degree and marks sheets/Caste Certificate/Disability Certificate/Proof of Govt. Servant/Ex. Servicemen/1st page of Admit Cards duly signed by the invigilator at the examination centre etc., as applicable in the E-dossier module in OARs link in his/her individual account in OARS module. Short listing is being made on the basis of marks obtained in Tier-I-G written examination for 200 marks. The e-dossier link will be available from 07 September to 21 September 2026

Candidates should make sure that all the required documents are uploaded within the specified period. Failure to submit the e-dossierwithin the given timeline can lead to rejection of candidature.

How to Download DSSSB MTS Marks 2026?

The step-by-step process to download the result is given below:

Step 1: Visit the official DSSSB website i.e. dsssbonline.nic.in

Step 2: Click on ’Declaration of marks of candidates for thePost of Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) under post code 812/24 in various 15 Department, GNCTD & Calling of e-dossiers from the shortlisted candidates.’

Step 3: Enter your details

Step 5: Download Delhi MTS Result 2026 and take the print-out of the result.

What If There Is a Technical Problem While Uploading theE-Dossier?

DSSSB has provided a provision for candidates who are unable to upload their documents because of a technical issue in the OARS module. They may report the same along with supporting evidence such as screenshots by e-mail to the DSSSB helpdesk i.e. [email protected]. A window of the next 48 hours (after expiry of e-dossier submission period) will be provided for reporting such technical glitches. In case a technical glitch is substantiated, an additional period of three days will be granted for uploading the documents in e-dossier system. However, this facility will be available only to those candidates who report the technical glitch within the specified timeline.

DSSSB MTS Qualifying Marks 2026

The minimum qualifying marks for different categories (UR/SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD/ExSM/) are given below:

  • General/EWS: 40%
  • OBC (Delhi): 35%
  • SC/ST/PH(PWD): 30%
  • Ex-servicemen will be given 5% relaxation in their respective categories subject to a minimum of 30%.

DSSSB MTS Result FAQs

Ques: Is DSSSB MTS Result Released ?

Answer: Yes, the result has been announced on 04 September 2026.

Ques: How many students are selected for the next round.

Answer: A total of 1732 candidates have been selected for the exam.

Ques: When can I fill e-dossier ?

Answer: The e-dossier link shall be activated for a period of 15 days w.e.f 07/09/2026 to 21/09/2026.

Ques: What is the case, when two or more candidates secure same marks

Answer: If there are two or more candidates in the same category having equal marks in the exam, then

  • (a) In case where the marks are equal, the candidate senior in age is to be placed higher in merit.

  • (b) In case where the dates of birth are also the same, the candidate whose first name comes first in Alphabetical order (in English) is to be placed higher in merit.
